The included 24W external power supply powers connected accessories but does not charge the host laptop. items.description: AGPTEK External CD/DVD Drive for Laptops - Many modern laptops no longer have built-in CD/DVD drives, making it impossible to insert CDs or DVDs to play music, watch movies, back up data or install systems. The AGPTEK external drive is the perfect solution, plug and play with no additional drivers required. Ensure the drive is recognized: Insert the external optical drive into the computer. After the Windows system recognizes the optical drive, the "DVD RW Drive" icon will be displayed. The Mac OS computer will not display the device icon until the disc is placed in the optical drive and the disc is read successfully. If the computer fails to recognize the optical drive, it may be that the computer's driver is missing or the output current is insufficient. About data cable & power cord: 1.The USB data cable is built into the bottom of the drive.(Note: The total length of the data cable is only about 10.24 inches / 26 cm.) 2.The charging cord is a separate USB cord that comes with the package. The charging cord cannot be used as a data cable alone, it must be used together with the USB data cable built into the back of the drive. 3.It's better to use the 5V charger/power bank to increase the power if your computer don't have enough power to support the external drive. (Note: For the Apple computers, you need to connect the external CD/DVD drive to the mac/macbook/imac through the USB A/C data cable first, and then connect the 5V charger/power bank to the external CD/DVD drive through the charging cord, otherwise the Apple computer will not recognize the external CD/DVD drive.) WINDOWS 11 Requirements: WINDOWS 11 needs a media player (such as VLC ) and a network connection. Reading and writing speed: 1.This CD/DVD drive supports USB 3.0 and can provide data transfer speeds of up to 5Gbps. Although it has up to 8x DVD read/write speed and 24x CD read/write speed, the drive reads and writes CD/DVD discs at speeds that increase from the inner circle to the outer circle, and the starting speed is usually lower, reaching the maximum speed when reaching the outermost circle. 2.Recommended speeds (CD: Reading Speed: 24x or lower/Writing Speed: 8x to 16x; DVD: Reading Speed: 8x or lower/Writing Speed: 4x to 8x). For DVDs, slower writing speeds like 4x or 8x are often ideal to ensure data integrity, particularly for high-capacity or dual-layer discs. These speeds allow for more precise data encoding, reducing the risk of read errors in the future.

Expanse: Videographer flies backward and ascends, with the camera locked on the subject, and records a video. Circle: Videographer circles around the subject. Rocket: Videographer ascends with the camera pointing downward. Spotlight: Videographer rotates while keeping the object of interest within the frame. items.name: DJI - RC Pro 2 Controller for Mavic 4 Pro Drone
items.description: DJI RC Pro 2 remote controller puts professional-grade aerial filmmaking at your fingertips. Its powerful 7-inch high-bright Mini-LED display delivers stunning visuals, while the rotatable screen instantly syncs with the drone's gimbal for vertical shooting. The enterprise-level multibeam high-gain antennas ensures ultra-reliable video transmission. With its integrated collapsible design, the RC Pro 2 powers on when extended and automatically deploys its control sticks so you can start creating instantly. Plus, capture high-quality audio with the built-in mic or pair it with the DJI Mic series. From design to experience, DJI RC Pro 2 is the ultimate companion for DJI camera drones.Flagship Display, Unforgettable Visuals DJI RC Pro 2's Mini-LED screen delivers flagship-monitor performance, featuring an ultra-high 2000-nit peak brightness, 1600-nit sustained brightness, and a 1,000,000:1 contrast ratio. It supports 10-bit color and covers 98% of the DCI-P3 color gamut, ensuring exceptional display quality. Not only does it display real-time HDR footage captured by the Mavic 4 Pro, it also accurately reproduces D-Log/D-Log M/HLG video through assistive display functions, giving you precise control over your visuals during creation. Collapsible Design, Extend and Start Creating RC Pro 2 features a smart collapsible design that powers on when extended, with joysticks rising seamlessly alongside the screen for swift, smooth operation. Adjustable screen stands allow you to find the ideal angle, adding a masterful touch to elevate your creative flow.Rotatable Screen for Instant Vertical Shooting When used with Mavic 4 Pro or Mini 4 Pro, RC Pro 2 enables synchronized gimbal rotation, allowing instant vertical shooting when the screen is rotated. Capture high-resolution content with an upgraded 1/2-inch Sony CMOS sensor that supports 48MP stills and 4K/30fps video with HDR, offering wide dynamic range and enhanced performance in a variety of lighting conditions. The F1.8 aperture and 4-in-1 pixel technology work together to reduce image noise and improve clarity. ATOM 2 includes a range of shooting options like Burst, Bracketing, and Interval modes, along with 5x slow motion, 4x digital zoom, and defog mode for added creative flexibility. Vertical shooting mode makes it easy to produce social media-ready content, while features like Dolly Zoom and P-Log mode provide options for stylized and post-editable footage. AI-powered tracking modes—Spotlight, Follow, and Parallel—enable consistent subject tracking with minimal manual control. Panorama modes (Wide Angle, 180°, and Sphere) help capture expansive views, and AI Night mode enhances visibility during low-light recording. The PixSync 4.0 system delivers stable 1080p/30fps real-time video transmission with approximately 120ms latency and up to 10 km range under optimal conditions. The included remote controller features a directional antenna for stronger signal reception and consistent connection. SmartTransfer allows direct 4K file downloads to your smartphone via Wi-Fi at speeds up to 25MB/s, streamlining content sharing. The intelligent battery supports up to 32 minutes of flight per charge, and the Parallel Charging Hub can charge three batteries simultaneously in about 1.3 hours, enabling up to 96 minutes of total flight time. Ergonomic controller design offers comfortable handling, and customizable controls let users adjust settings to match their flying preferences. Updated propeller design helps reduce noise and maintain stable hover. One-key takeoff and landing, along with GNSS-based positioning and Dynamic Home Point updates, contribute to easier operation and improved flight accuracy, especially for newer users. The Potensic Eve app provides access to flight records, smart reminders, file management, and customer support. Potensic Care coverage is included to support accidental damage protection. The ATOM 2 offers a well-rounded feature set in a travel-friendly design, suitable for a wide range of aerial photography and videography needs.

items.name: Potensic - ATOM Fly More Combo Drone with Remote Controller - Gray
items.description: The Potensic ATOM Fly More Combo Drone offers high-quality imaging with a 4K camera, 12MP photos, and a 3-axis gimbal, ensuring smooth, stable shots from any angle. It features intelligent flight modes like QuickShots (Pull-away, Rocket, Circle, Spiral, and Boomerang), as well as smarter visual tracking that automatically follows your subject. With PixSync 3.0 technology, enjoy a maximum video transmission range of 6 km, and capture distant subjects with 1x, 2x, or 3x digital zoom. Weighing less than 249g, it’s ultra-light and regulation-friendly, making it easy to take anywhere. Plus, with 32 minutes of flight time and advanced camera settings, the ATOM is perfect for both beginners and experienced drone pilots.

items.name: Potensic - ATOM GPS Drone with 4K 3-Axis Gimbal Camera - White
items.description: What sets the ATOM GPS Drone apart is its fusion of advanced technology and user-friendly design, making it a top choice for both amateur and professional aerial photographers and videographers. This high-tech drone is engineered with a 4K 3-Axis Gimbal Camera that captures high-resolution video and 12MP still images with unparalleled clarity. The 3-axis gimbal ensures smooth, stable footage, even under windy conditions, elevating your aerial shots to cinematic quality.The ATOM GPS Drone is not only efficient but also durable, designed to withstand the challenges of outdoor filming. With a maximum flight time of 32 minutes and a transmission range of up to 6km, this drone offers extended opportunities to explore and capture your adventures from the sky. The ultra-precise GPS positioning, coupled with a Sony CMOS sensor, provides a max tilt range of +20° to -90°, allowing for a broad and vivid capture of scenes.Enhanced smoothness is guaranteed thanks to the advanced 3-axis gimbal stabilization technology and an upgraded brushless motor, which work together to produce ultra-smooth footage and sharp still images, regardless of the environment. The PotensicPro App further improves the user experience by offering easy adjustments to picture and video settings, including ISO, shutter speed, white balance, resolution, and frame rates.The ATOM GPS Drone's smarter visual tracking employs a new algorithm for recognizing moving subjects, simplifying the process of automating shots for consistent and stable footage. With improved ultra-sensitive u-blox GNSS platform, the drone boasts enhanced performance and navigation, significantly reducing the risk of flyaway situations.This lightweight drone is incredibly portable, easily fitting in your pocket, making it the perfect travel companion for on-the-go photography. Optimized power performance is achieved through all-new FOC ESC drivers, which enhance flight efficiency, reduce power consumption, and ensure smoother, more stable performance.The ATOM GPS Drone maintains a stable and reliable connection over long distances, thanks to its 6km control range and Pixsync 3.0 Transmission, which ensures the delivery of 4K/UHD shots with precision. Precise hovering is achieved through a combination of GNSS, a downward vision system, and an infrared sensing system, allowing the drone to hover accurately and steadily.Fly longer and farther with the Potensic Intelligent Flight Battery, which provides up to 32 minutes of flight time and includes protection against overcharging and over-discharging. The optional fast charging hub can recharge three flight batteries in just about 1.5 hours, ensuring you're always ready for your next flight.Creative shots are made easy with intelligent flight modes, including QuickShots like Pull-away, Rocket, Circle, Spiral, and Boomerang, which allow for dynamic and engaging footage. The SurgeFly Flight Control System offers three speed modes to suit different filming needs, and the drone can take off and land with just one step, thanks to the easy-to-use app.Smart auto-return functionality ensures the drone comes back safely in case of emergencies such as low battery, weak signal, or loss of control. The app also includes intuitive instructions and voice prompts to help users master their flight experience. With Remote Fota, firmware upgrades are seamless, keeping your drone up-to-date with the latest features and improvements.In summary, the ATOM GPS Drone with 4K 3-Axis Gimbal Camera is a sophisticated, durable, and efficient choice for anyone looking to capture stunning aerial footage with ease and confidence.

items.name: Bundle - DJI - Avata 2 Fly Smart Combo with 3 Batteries
items.description: The Total Package Fully Experience Flight DJI Avata 2 delivers an adrenaline-pumping immersive FPV drone experience with improved imaging, safety, and battery life. Amp up the fun when you pair Avata 2 with the new DJI Goggles N3 and DJI RC Motion 3.Flipping Awesome Creative Edge Easy ACRO Soar, dive, and roll for stunning aerial footage with a single push. Capturing epic FPV footage with DJI RC Motion 3 and Avata 2 is easier than ever.One-Push Flip 360 Degree front/back flip, adding fresh twists to your footage.One-Push Roll Roll 360 Degree left/right, turning any shot from meh to magic.One-Push 180 Degree Drift High-speed lateral drifts to yaw spin 180 Degree past objects and swiftly pull away, achieving dramatic visuals.Advanced Maneuvers Fly nimbly through tight spaces with the new DJI FPV Remote Controller 3 in Manual mode to showcase flying prowess and gutsy creativity.Tight Shots in Super-Wide 4K Create breathtaking visuals with Avata 2's 155 Degree FOV and its ability to swiftly approach and pull away from subjects. New pilots can quickly master aerobatic shots and capture fast-moving dynamic low-altitude shots that other drones can't.1/1.3-inch Image Sensor The upgraded 1/1.3-inch image sensor expands the captured dynamic range, handling low-light conditions more effectively to capture outstanding footage on every flight.Immersion Reimagined 4K/60fps HDR Videos Unleash your true aerial potential. The 4K/60fps HDR on Avata 2 captures all the awesome of high-speed flight. In the goggles, you can adjust the sharpness and noise reduction levels for more finely tuned videos.RockSteady Equipped with DJI's latest stabilization algorithm, Avata 2 captures smooth, steady footage even when flying at high speeds or in windy conditions.HorizonSteady HorizonSteady handles horizontal rotations up to 360 Degree , ensuring the captured footage remains locked on the horizon even if the drone turns sharply or sways dramatically.155 Degree Ultra-Wide-Angle FOV Amplify your vision and increase the immersion of low-altitude, high-speed flights. Avata 2 offers ultra-wide-angle, wide-angle, and normal-angle FOV options giving you the ability to adjust to the scenario.10-bit D-Log M Capture rich detail in highlights and shadows and enhance content post-production opportunities while further streamlining color-grading.Got You Covered - Comprehensive Safety The updated integrated propeller guard design of Avata 2 makes it lighter and more agile, enabling it to navigate freely in tight spaces. Releasing the accelerator on RC Motion 3 or pressing the lock button brings the drone to a halt, allowing you to handle unexpected situations calmly. In addition, the automatic Return to Home (RTH) function is initiated when the drone's battery is low or in case of signal loss, adding an extra layer of security.Advanced Positioning with New Sensors New binocular fisheye sensors enable downward and backward visual positioning during low-altitude and indoor flights, enhancing flight stability and safety.Turtle Mode Avata 2 can automatically flip itself back into takeoff position when upside down with Turtle mode enabled, so you can quickly get airborne again.Excellence in Everything - Flight Time/Video Transmission The Sky's the Limit With Longer Flight Avata 2 boasts a maximum flight time of 23 minutes and supports PD fast charging, so you can quickly recharge it and take to the skies again.The new DJI Avata 2 Two-Way Charging Hub features a power accumulation function, allowing the transfer of remaining power from multiple batteries to the one with the highest charge level, giving you an "extra battery" in critical moments.O4 Video Transmission, Enhanced Perception DJI O4 video transmission's enhanced stability lets you fully immerse yourself in each flight and provides greater safety. Its two-transmitter, four-receiver, four-antenna design ensures strong anti-interference performance, and it boasts up to 13 km of maximum video transmission distance, a transmission latency as low as 24 ms, 1080p/100fps high-definition image quality, and a maximum transmission bitrate of 60Mbps.Boundless Passion, Wireless Sharing Watch the DJI Goggles 3 live feed from Avata 2 on your smart device's DJI Fly App. Connect up to 5 m away. Sharing the excitement of FPV just got easier, and learning how to fly is more accessible than ever.

items.description: The Propeller Guard for the Air 3 Drone is a meticulously crafted accessory, designed to offer superior protection for your drone's propellers. Its efficient design not only enhances the safety of your drone but also contributes to its stylish aesthetic. Whether you're a professional drone operator or a hobbyist, this Propeller Guard for the Air 3 Drone is an essential accessory for maintaining the longevity and performance of your drone. items.name: DJI - Neo 2 4K Drone Fly More Combo, No Remote
items.description: DJI Neo 2 is DJI's most compact drone equipped with omnidirectional obstacle sensing and features such as gesture control, SelfieShot, and ActiveTrack for more creative ways to fly. Even beginners can get started effortlessly. Think of it as your personal follow-me camera drone, always ready to capture your most exciting moments. Palm Takeoff & Landing, Gesture Control Faster, Smoother Tracking With ActiveTrack Easy Moment Capture With SelfieShot Omnidirectional Obstacle Sensing and Versatile Flight 4K High-Quality Imaging Lightweight, Portable Design With Full-Coverage Propeller GuardsMaster Flight With EaseDJI Neo 2 features an onboard display for intuitive shooting mode selection. To launch, point it at yourself and press the takeoff button with one hand to take off directly from your palm, then perform automatic camera movements. The new Return-to-Palm feature allows Neo 2 to precisely locate your palm, return safely, and land steadily, making flights easier than ever. More Ways to Control, More FunNeo 2 can follow you effortlessly even without a remote controller, ensuring every exciting moment is captured.Gesture ControlEasily adjust Neo 2's direction and proximity with one or both hands. Point your palm toward the drone to guide it up, down, or side to side, or use both palms for precise control over proximity. No remote controller is needed for camera angle adjustment.Voice Control via MobileNeo 2 supports voice control, so you can send flying commands using your smartphone or Bluetooth earphones with complete freedom, whether on a run or cycling. When connected to your phone, it can capture audio and intelligently reduce noise, automatically filtering out propeller noise. This feature enables you to record content independently on your own.Mobile App ControlControl Neo 2 with virtual joysticks on the DJI Fly app interface and quickly delve into the joy of flying with no need for a separate purchase of a remote controller.Smart Capture for Sharp ResultsDJI Neo 2 supports ActiveTrack and SelfieShot, automatically framing subjects for smooth, hands-free shooting from start to finish. Multiple intelligent shooting modes unlock fresh perspectives and spark creativity in seconds. Combined with 4K video recording , Neo 2 delivers crisp, detailed, cinematic-quality footage.Faster, Smoother Tracking With ActiveTrackWith enhanced tracking performance, Neo 2 enables smooth and stable tracking for running, cycling, and more. In open areas, it can track at speeds of up to 12m/s, offering faster response and improved stability.Faster Tracking SpeedWith a maximum tracking speed of 12 m/s, Neo 2 smoothly follows you even during running or cycling. Added omnidirectional obstacle sensing ensures safer tracking from the front and sides, allowing you to capture fast-motion moments with ease.12 m/s Maximum tracking speedMore Tracking DirectionsEight-direction tracking (forward, backward, left, right, and four diagonals) enables smoother, more natural follow shots and expands creative possibilities. In complex environments, the drone can switch to rear tracking mode, steadily keeping the subject in focus and enabling creative freedom with confidence.Easy Moment Capture With SelfieShotCapture solo or group moments hands-free with SelfieShot, which lets you effortlessly switch between waist-up, full-body, and long shots without a tripod or any extra assistance. Whether it's birthday parties, weekend picnics, or family outings, Neo 2 automatically composes every scene and maneuvers the camera as needed to capture your cherished moments with just a tap.4K High-Quality Imaging Neo 2 features a 12MP, 1/2-inch CMOS sensor with an f/2.2 aperture and high-performance image processor for clearer, low-noise footage. Shoot in 4K/60fps video, 4K/100fps slow motion, and 2.7K vertical video, all stabilized by a 2-axis gimbal. Stunning Footage Neo 2 captures impressive footage with true-to-life image quality.4K Video Neo 2 records 4K/60fps video and 4K/100fps slow-motion, delivering smooth and clear results.Portrait OptimizationFeaturing DJI's portrait optimization technology, Neo 2 enhances portraits' brightness, contrast, and skin tones, showcasing naturally radiant skin with vivid, lifelike expressions.2.7K Vertical ShootingNeo 2 supports 2.7K vertical video recording, ideal for social media sharing.Enhanced StabilizationThe 2-axis gimbal works with Electronic Image Stabilization (EIS) to deliver smooth, stabilized footage in any scenario.

This large sensor, enhanced by the new image-processing technology and intelligent algorithms, preserves even minute details in low-light conditions such as sunsets and nightscapes, delivering shots that are simply, effortlessly breathtaking. With the 48mm Med-Tele mode, subjects stand out more prominently in the frame, while portrait optimization algorithms capture every expression with remarkable clarity. Scenic Nature City Twilight Outdoor AdventuresMed-Tele ModeWith 2x zoom, the new 48mm Med-Tele mode now offers higher image resolution than the digital zoom on previous DJI Mini Pro series. Subjects stand out with greater texture, adding depth to your aerial shots.Portrait OptimizationFeaturing DJI's portrait optimization technology, DJI Mini 5 Pro enhances portraits' brightness, contrast, and skin tones. The 48mm Med-Tele mode further highlights subjects with true-to-life vibrance.Compact, Yet Cinematic4K/60fps HDR VideoThe HDR video mode offers up to 14 stops of dynamic range, capturing cinematic footage in high-contrast scenes, such as detailed views of cloud textures and other elements during sunrise and sunset.4K/120fps Slow-Motion VideoMini 5 Pro supports slow-motion video recording at 4K/120fps, ensuring stunning clarity and fluidity with high resolution and frame rates. In D-Log M and HLG color modes, the maximum ISO is raised to 3200, allowing for greater brightness and more details in urban night scenes.True Vertical Shooting and 225 Degree Flexible Gimbal RotationMini 5 Pro supports wide-angle roll rotation and true vertical shooting, bringing greater freedom and possibilities to camera movement. Both manual control and intelligent modes provide greater flexibility in camera angles and flight routes, allowing for more creative compositions. Even when shooting upward at tall buildings or from challenging angles, unique viewpoints that were once difficult to capture can now be achieved with ease, fully unlocking creative inspiration.225 Degree Gimbal Rotation for Dynamic Camera MovementWith 225 Degree roll rotation, the gimbal enables flexible and dynamic camera movement. Paired with intelligent modes like QuickShot Rotate, Timelapse, Spotlight, and Waypoint Flight, capturing creative rotating footage is now easy.True Vertical Shooting for Instant SharingExcellent for skyscrapers, waterfalls, and vibrant city scenes, instantly shoot vertical videos and photos and share. No cropping needed. Every photo and video is ready for social media, filling the screen with vibrant, full-frame brilliance.Confident Flight With Nightscape Omnidirectional Obstacle SensingMini 5 Pro features a forward-facing LiDAR and multiple vision sensors for nightscape omnidirectional obstacle sensing, making return-to-home safer. With sufficient light, it can memorize flight routes, enabling safe takeoff and return even without satellite signal.

The Ultra Wide Lens Mod is perfect for capturing action-packed scenes and epic landscapes, while the Macro Lens Mod allows for detailed close-up shots. Enhance your footage with Neutral Density Filters for professional motion blur or achieve cinematic anamorphic shots with the Anamorphic Lens Mod. The camera intelligently detects attached lenses or filters, automatically adjusting settings for optimal results.Built to withstand the elements, the HERO13 Black is rugged and waterproof up to 33ft (10m), making it ideal for adventures in mud, snow, or water. Its water-repelling lens cover minimizes lens flare, ensuring crystal-clear photos and videos. The award-winning HyperSmooth 6.0 video stabilization ensures impossibly smooth footage, while the built-in 360-degree Horizon Lock keeps your shots steady even during full rotations.Equipped with a powerful 1900mAh Enduro battery, the HERO13 Black offers extended runtimes in all conditions, from extreme heat to freezing cold. Enjoy up to 1.5 hours of continuous recording at 4K30 or 5.3K30, and over 2.5 hours at 1080p30. The camera also features versatile power options, including the Contacto Waterproof Magnetic Power Cable and Door Kit for quick external power connections, and a Dual Battery Charger + Integrated Powerbank for on-the-go charging.The HERO13 Black offers unparalleled mounting flexibility with three options, including the new Magnetic Latch Mount for quick swaps, built-in mounting fingers for secure attachment, and 1/4-20 mounting threads for use with tripods and standard accessories. Capture hands-free footage effortlessly with voice commands, perfect for when your hands are occupied with handlebars, ski poles, or tow ropes.For advanced users, the HERO13 Black supports HLG-HDR video, recording in Hybrid Log Gamma for enhanced color depth and realism. The camera's 1/1.9" image sensor allows for widescreen, vertical, and full-frame capture, providing maximum versatility for any shooting scenario. With 10-bit color and Log encoding, your videos will display over 1 billion colors, offering smoother gradations and more detail for post-production editing.Additional features include Bluetooth audio connectivity for wireless microphone use, audio tuning for optimal sound recording, and GPS with performance stickers to overlay telemetry data on your videos. The front and rear LCD screens ensure perfect framing for every shot, whether vlogging or capturing selfies. Customize your shooting experience with preset options for quick access to your favorite settings.Finally, the HERO13 Black simplifies the editing process with the GoPro Quik app, which automatically creates highlight videos with beat-synced music and effects. Your footage is uploaded to the cloud while charging, and highlight videos are sent directly to your phone, ready to share with the world. Embrace the endless creative possibilities with the GoPro HERO13 Black Camera bundle.

Best for: connecting action cameras and single-board computers with Micro HDMI to monitors, TVs, and external recorders. Not for: Mini HDMI Type C devices or 4K@60Hz output. RoHS compliant.

items.name: Switch 2 + Mario Kart World Bundle

Limited quantities. While supplies last.

Nintendo Switch 2 is the next evolution of the Nintendo Switch system—packed with upgrades and fun ways to connect and play together!

Discover Nintendo Switch 2

Your games will leap to life on the vivid, 7.9” 1080p screen that showcases the system’s powerful processing and graphics performance. The updated dock also supports up to 4K resolution and frame rates up to 120 fps with compatible games and TVs. The reimagined Joy-Con 2 controllers snap into place with magnetic connectors—and each controller can even be used as a mouse in compatible games. Plus, you can still enjoy compatible games from your existing Nintendo Switch library.

Connect with friends and family with GameChat

Once GameChat is setp up, press the C Button on your right Joy-Con 2 to start it up, a seamless way to voice chat with your friends, share your game screen, and connect via video chat with a compatible USB-C camera (sold separately). Nintendo Switch 2 also has a built-in microphone that filters out noise around you for a clear experience. It’s like hanging out together…from wherever you are.

Start playing right away with Mario Kart World

Zip around courses in a vast world where everything is connected in the Mario Kart World game—exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2. Race along grassy plains, bustling cities, wide-open waters, big ol' volcanos, and more—plus everything in between. Play together on the same system with up to 4 players or go for the top spot in online races with up to 24 players. Start a GameChat session in Mario Kart World and whether you're competing in a race or simply exploring the open road, it's like you're zooming around together.

Gear up for exclusive games and more

Nintendo Switch 2 is the exclusive home to games like Mario Kart World, Donkey Kong Bananza, and more. You can also purchase upgrade packs for certain Nintendo Switch games like The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom, Super Mario Party Jamboree, and Kirby and the Forgotten Land for enhanced experiences and new content!

Features:

One system, three play modes: TV, Tabletop, and Handheld.

Larger, vivid, 7.9” LCD touch screen with support for HDR and up to 120 fps.

Dock that supports 4K when connected to a compatible TV.

GameChat lets you voice chat, share your game screen, and connect via video chat as you play.

256GB internal storage (a portion of which is used by the system), expandable with microSD Express cards (sold separately).

Nintendo Switch 2 plays compatible physical and digital Nintendo Switch games.

Joy-Con 2 controllers attach magnetically and offer mouse controls in compatible games.

Same-system multiplayer, local wireless, and online multiplayer.

Mario Kart World lets you hit the open road with Mario and friends!

TV and game must be compatible with 4K resolution.

Frame rate is fixed to a maximum of 60 fps for 4K output.

items.description: The Sony PlayStation 4 Slim Gaming Console is smaller, lighter, and more energy efficient than the original PS4. Despite its smaller design, it still provides the same performance found on earlier PS4 models - and it does so more quietly. It also supports High Dynamic Range (HDR) gaming and content, which takes advantage of increased color depth and contrast on compatible displays.  Compact Design     The PS4 is now 30% smaller, 16% lighter, and 28% more energy efficient than the original PS4. Despite the smaller design, the redesigned PS4 still provides the same performance, so you can play at 1080p with ease.   High Dynamic Range (HDR) Support     The PS4 is fully compatible with the HDR10 specification. High Dynamic Range (HDR) is a display standard that allows for increased color depth and improved contrast compared to Standard Dynamic Range found on traditional HDTVs. In general, HDR-enabled content played on an HDR-compatible TV produces a noticeably fuller, richer image that is closer to what the human eye naturally sees. That means much deeper black levels that retain finer details, brighter highlights, and a much wider color spectrum than on traditional HDTVs.   1.84 Teraflops of PlayStation 4 Graphics     The PlayStation's graphics processing unit (GPU) contains a unified array of 18 Compute Units, which collectively generate 1.84 teraflops of processing power that can be applied freely to graphics, simulation tasks, or a mixture of the two.

Once GameChat is set up, press the C Button on your right Joy-Con 2 to start it up, a seamless way to voice chat with your friends, share your game screen, and connect via video chat with a compatible USB-C camera (sold separately). Nintendo Switch 2 also has a built-in microphone that filters out noise around you for a clear experience. It’s like hanging out together…from wherever you are.

Gear up for exclusive games and more

Nintendo Switch 2 is the exclusive home to games like Mario Kart World, Donkey Kong Bananza, and more. You can also purchase upgrade packs for certain Nintendo Switch games like The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom, Super Mario Party Jamboree, and Kirby and the Forgotten Land for enhanced experiences and new content!

Features:

The next evolution of Nintendo Switch. One system, three play modes: TV, Tabletop, and Handheld.

Larger, vivid, 7.9” LCD touch screen with support for HDR and up to 120 fps.

Dock that supports 4K when connected to a compatible TV.

GameChat lets you voice chat, share your game screen, and connect via video chat as you play.

256GB internal storage (a portion of which is used by the system), expandable with microSD Express cards (sold separately).

Nintendo Switch 2 plays physical and digital Nintendo Switch games.

Joy-Con 2 controllers attach magnetically and now offer mouse controls.

Same-system multiplayer, local wireless, and online multiplayer.

TV and game must be compatible with 4K resolution.

Frame rate is fixed to a maximum of 60 fps for 4K output.

items.name: Pokémon Legends: Arceus - Nintendo Switch – OLED Model, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch Lite
items.description: Action meets RPG as the Pokémon series reaches a new frontier. Get ready for a new kind of grand, Pokémon adventure in Pokémon Legends: Arceus, a brand-new game from Game Freak that blends action and exploration with the RPG roots of the Pokémon series. Embark on survey missions in the ancient Hisui region. Explore natural expanses to catch wild Pokémon by learning their behavior, sneaking up, and throwing a well-aimed Poké Ball. You can also toss the Poké Ball containing your ally Pokémon near a wild Pokémon to seamlessly enter battle. Travel across land, sea, and sky on the backs of Pokémon to explore every corner of the Hisui region. Travel to the Hisui region—the Sinnoh of old—and build the region’s first Pokédex. Your adventure takes place in the expansive natural majesty of the Hisui region, where you are tasked with studying Pokémon to complete the region’s first Pokédex. Mount Coronet rises from the center, surrounded on all sides by areas with distinct environments. In this era—long before the events of the Pokémon Brilliant Diamond and Pokémon Shining Pearl games—you can find newly discovered Pokémon like Wyrdeer, an evolution of Stantler, and new regional forms like Hisuian Growlithe, Hisuian Zorua, and Hisuian Zoroark! Along the way, uncover the mystery surrounding the Mythical Pokémon known as Arceus. A free software update brings special mass outbreaks and new challenges. In the free Daybreak update, you will begin investigating mysterious mass outbreaks of Pokémon that are popping up all over the Hisui region. You’ll also have a chance to battle powerful opponents like Legendary Pokémon in Eternal Battle Reverie and wardens at the Jubilife Village training grounds. Daybreak content will be available after viewing the game’s end credits. The Eternal Battle Reverie will become available after completing all missions. Bleacher Report - "Pokemon Legends: Arceus is such a blast to play and a step in the right direction..." – N/A - Game Informer - "Pokémon Legends: Arceus is a beautiful adventure thanks mainly to its colorful art style…" – 8.75/10 - Polygon - "There’s always a new type of Pokémon around every corner, and it makes the world feel alive." – N/A - The Verge - "... gives off the feeling of a real place full of danger and secrets and all of the joy and excitement those things can bring." – N/A - IGN - “…reimagines how you go about capturing and battling Pokémon…” – 7/10 - As the protagonist of this game, you'll meet Professor Laventon, who studies the ecology of Pokémon as a member of the Galaxy Expedition Team. After receiving an assignment or a request and preparing for your next excursion, you'll set out from Jubilife Village to study one of the various areas of the Hisui region. There may be certain Pokémon behaviors—or even entire species—that you witness only under the right conditions, such as during a particular time of day or in certain kinds of weather. Word has it that some Pokémon even act in ways that are unique to their species! Keep an eye on your health while out adventuring—take too much damage from wild Pokémon attacks or falling from high places and you’ll be unable to go on! Battles in the Hisui region also have some unique properties. For the first time in the series, your Pokémon unleash moves with the speedy agile style or the powerful strong style. These nobles are particularly powerful and are revered by the people of the region. But some strange phenomenon is now causing them to suddenly fly into a frenzy. To quell them, you will have to hit them with balms made from these noble Pokémon’s favorite foods. Jubilife Village is the main base of your adventures in Pokémon Legends: Arceus. In Pokémon Brilliant Diamond and Pokémon Shining Pearl, this village has grown to be the bustling Jubilife City. items.name: Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World - Nintendo Switch 2
items.description: The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition has faster frame rates and higher resolution, but that’s not all—there’s also an additional story in which Kirby must use his amazing abilities, including some all-new Mouthful Modes, to clear a trail through uncharted territory after the world is struck by a powerful meteor. Hope you’re hungry for an unforgettable adventure! Get a mouthful of real-world objects for powerful transformations. Feeling hungry? Kirby can inhale real-world objects and transform using Mouthful Mode! Why get one drink from a vending machine when you can swallow the whole thing? Then, use your boxy body to shoot out cans at baddies. Consume a car to gain some wheels and slam through walls. Sit back and take it all in…literally. Join up with a pointy partner, Bandana Waddle Dee, in co-op play. Pass a Joy-Con 2 controller to a buddy to play as the spear-wielding Bandana Waddle Dee and help each other explore and battle through this colorful world. While Kirby can float and inhale enemies, Bandana Waddle Dee can spin and stab with his sturdy spear. Find friendship in this Forgotten Land and save the Waddle Dees! The tough puff is truly put to the test in dynamic boss battles that will keep you dancing about the arena. Choose from two difficulty modes for either a light, breezy adventure or a more challenging experience. Each themed stage you travel through will hide several friendly Waddle Dees in peril! Save them to grow the home base of your adventure, the once-deserted Waddle Dee Town. The Waddle Dees you rescue will unlock shops, leaderboards, and the ability to evolve Copy Abilities to make them stronger. You’ll also be able to enjoy some of the townsfolk’s favorite games. Use compatible amiibo accessories or Present Codes at Waddle Dee-liveries for useful in-game items. Whether you're tracking opponents in FPS titles or making precise movements in platforming games, every input feels smooth and controlled. As Michael, players wear the mask, become the Boogeyman, and stalk innocent residents with relentless obsession. Utilizing a nightmarish array of abilities, Michael leverages shadows and stealth to satisfy his bloodthirst. This doesn’t mean Haddonfield is going down without a fight. Frightened townsfolk will call the local authorities and even fight back when threatened, incentivizing Michael to avoid detection. And for the first time ever, fans of the transformative original film will have the option to witness the haunting narrative events surrounding "The Night He Came Home" through the eyes of Michael Myers in a standalonesingleplayer story mode. As a Hero of Haddonfield, it’s your job to alert the residents of Haddonfield to the impending evil and help them escape before falling victim to Michael’s unyielding pursuit. In dynamic and ever-changing 1v4 asymmetricalmultiplayermatches,heroplayers must arm themselves with everyday household items, weapons, andknowledge to combat an unpredictable and unkillable enemy. Convincingtownsfolk and contacting the police will lead to increasingly powerful andthorough neighborhood patrols. To even the odds, you can command and equipNPCs with weapons to outsmart or even overpower The Shape, providingprecious windows for escape. This immersive horror sandbox is powered by Unreal Engine 5 to deliver engaging and dynamic gameplay systems, life-like NPCs, hauntingly realisticvisuals, cinema-quality lighting, and endless scares for you and your friends. Asymmetrical horror comes home in Halloween: The Game.

items.description: Retro Gaming just got Micro-sized with the Super Micro Centipede Keychain Gamer from HyperMegaTech. It's a small, affordable way to add another piece of licensed retro gaming hardware to a shelf, a desk, or a set of keys.

Includes a pair of ergonomically molded hand grips for your Joy-Cons that work in handheld, tabletop, and docked modes, while the adjustable Controller Holder maximizes comfort whenever your Joy-Cons are detached from the system. A pair of aim-enhancing Stick Grips complete the package, providing some much-needed height and grip for the stock Switch 2 thumbsticks.

items.name: Thrustmaster - T.Flight Hotas NEO Ace Combat 8 Edition for Xbox Series X, Xbox ONE, Windows - Black
items.description: Master the skies with T.FLIGHT HOTAS NEO ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE Edition, officially licensed for Xbox Series X, Xbox ONE and PC. Feel all the intensity of your battles thanks to the built-in vibrations, plus enjoy 16-bit precision and a more immersive flight experience.

items.name: Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea - Nintendo Switch 2
items.description: Embark on an unforgettable journey in the enchanting world of Teradea, where peaceful farm life meets thrilling adventure! Raised in the quiet comfort of Bloomfield Village, your life is about to change forever. A mysterious mist creeps from the Forest of Echoes, wild beasts roam under the cover of night, and strange disasters threaten villages across the land.  Explore a vast, living landscape filled with hidden caves, remote islands, and lively towns. Build your farm, forge friendships, and even find love as you shape your destiny in Teradea. Travel alongside your animals—each with special abilities that help you leap across terrain, break through obstacles, and uncover valuable treasures. Along the way, you’ll meet unforgettable allies like the Harvest Goddess and ingenious inventor Doc Jr., befriend powerful Guardian Spirits, and take on the mysteries behind earthquakes, violent storms, and a looming darkness that threatens everything you know.

items.name: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album - Best Buy Exclusive - Clear Pink with Purple Splatter Vinyl - Includes Exclusive 12x24 poster
items.description: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album on clear pink with purple splatter vinyl. The 2LP, gatefold jacket includes a Best Buy exclusive 12x24 poster.  Atlantic Records and Rockstar Games announce Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, the upcoming official soundtrack album from the biggest, most immersive evolution of the groundbreaking Grand Theft Auto series yet; Grand Theft Auto VI. Launching November 19 alongside the hotly anticipated game, Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album features 34 original tracks that capture the electric energy of Grand Theft Auto VI’s world of Vice City and Leonida, with a genre-defying roster of the most exciting and preeminent artists in the world.

items.name: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION (+ Exclusive Magic: The Gathering—FINAL FANTASY Promo Card) Day 1 Edition - PlayStation 5
items.description: As the world teeters on the brink of annihilation, the final battle against Sephiroth begins. A meteor mars the sky, monstrous planetary guardians wreak havoc across the globe, and the fires of war rage. Now, Cloud and his companions must stand against this chaos to not only decide the planet's fate, but to bring a legendary conflict to its conclusion. In the final chapter of the FINAL FANTASY VII Remake Series, the scale has never been larger, and the stakes have never been higher. Take to the skies and explore a boundless world, fight alongside a fully assembled party, master strategic and dynamic combat, and prepare yourself for the climactic finale. A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.

items.name: Hollow Knight - Nintendo Switch 2
items.description: Hollow Knight is a classically styled 2D action adventure across a vast interconnected world. Explore twisting caverns, ancient cities and deadly wastes; battle tainted creatures and befriend bizarre bugs; and solve ancient mysteries at the kingdom's heart.

items.name: Stage Tour Game + Kramer Wireless Guitar Controller Bundle - PlayStation 5
items.description: Get ready to go on tour with the official Stage Tour Game and Kramer Wireless Guitar Controller Bundle for PlayStation5 consoles.Pair Stage Tour for PlayStation5 consoles with the official RedOctane Games Stage Tour Kramer Wireless Guitar Controller. Play over 90 officially licensed songs, collect 180+ authentic in-game Gibson, Epiphone and Kramer guitars, discover 50+ bandmates, and experience new ways to play.Inspired by the unmistakable design of Kramer electric guitars, the Stage Tour Kramer Wireless Guitar Controller brings that iconic style to rhythm gaming with a Hall Effect Click Strum Bar, modern rubber membrane frets, ultra-low-latency wireless connectivity, and features built for a new generation.

items.name: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction - Nintendo Switch
items.description: Eternia is in peril! The nefarious Skeletor has uncovered the ancient Dragon Pearl of Destruction, a relic of unspeakable power. With the help of Evil-Lyn, he intends to perform a ritual that will plunge all of Eternia into eternal darkness. Only the Most Powerful Man in the Universe and his heroic allies stand in Skeletor’s way. Developed by the retro-specialists at Bitmap Bureau in collaboration with Mattel, this is the 2D arcade brawler fans have been waiting for since the Saturday mornings of their childhood. Take control of He-Man, Man-At-Arms, and Teela in a fast-paced, magic-brawler that blends the crunch of arcade classics with the high-fantasy action of the animated series. Harness character-specific moves, devastating special abilities, and screen-clearing magic to decimate the forces of evil.

items.name: Stupid Never Dies - PlayStation 5
items.description: Bite! Rip! Rise!!Set in a monster-ruled otherworldly dungeon, Stupid Never Dies puts you in control of Davy, a timid zombie living at the very bottom of monster society. Defeat enemies, level up, and collect strange items to grow stronger on your quest to bring Julia, a frozen human girl, back to life.Steal enemy abilities, customize your undead body with bizarre upgrades, and experience fast-paced combat packed with innovation. Developed by GPTRACK50, a new studio formed by veteran action game developers, Stupid Never Dies delivers a single-player 3D action RPG experience unlike anything you’ve played before.

items.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio SteelBook Edition - Nintendo Switch 2
items.description: Embrace yourself for the next evolution of fantasy JRPG coming October 11, 2024, Metaphor: ReFantazio! Enter the royal tournament to fight for the throne and for the future. Control your destiny,face your fears and awaken magical “Archetype” powers that liedormant in your heart.Team up with a compelling cast of characters and embark onan immersive journey that promises hours of captivatingexploration,dynamic combat, and exhilarating discovery.

items.name: Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen - Nintendo Switch 2
items.description: Dragon’s Dogma™2: Dark Arisen enriches the dynamic fantasy world and expansive adventures of Dragon’s Dogma™ 2 with unforgettable new tales and thrilling encounters, while bringing the pulse-pounding action game to Nintendo Switch 2 for the first time. The Dark Arisen Expansion summons the Arisen to the long-abandoned Northern region of Norgan, where they must join forces with the enigmatic Eir to unravel the secrets of the undying Fallen Dragon. The expansion also introduces 12 Lost Rites Dungeon Challenges.Arisen looking to tailor their appearance will also gain access to new options added to the robust Character Creator, including new hairstyles and tattoos.

items.name: Stage Tour Game + Kramer Wireless Guitar Controller Bundle - Nintendo Switch 2

items.name: Nintendo - amiibo - Chozo Statue - Metroid Ravenous Series - Multi
items.description: In the Metroid series of games, the Chozo are a highly intelligent, peaceful, and technologically advanced bird-like species. These sentinel statues depicting their likeness offer secrets and powers Samus can use to upgrade her suit. This amiibo figure is larger than standard size, and features the Chozo Statue in its iconic pose with knees raised and its palms extended forward. Details about functionality within the Metroid Ravenous game will be announced at a later date.

items.name: Ratatan Day 1 Edition - Nintendo Switch 2
items.description: Ratatan is diving onto the roguelike scene in this combination of rhythm and side-scroller action. Players can move to the groove alone or team up with friends in multiplayer mayhem suitable for up to four players!  Engage in huge melee brawls with more than 100 characters duking it out for supremacy. Defeat your enemies by riding the rhythm of Ratatan's catchy, toe-tapping soundtrack in this delightful, heartfelt adventure!

items.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest Feral Edition - Nintendo Switch 2
items.description: Step into the paws of your own original character and experience life among the Clans in Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest. Explore a vibrant wilderness filled with hidden paths, dangerous rivals, spiritual omens, and unforgettable adventures inspired by the world from the best-selling Warrior Cats books from Erin Hunter. Choose your Clan, forge bonds with allies, and rise through the ranks as you hunt prey, patrol territories, uncover secrets, and defend your home in strategic turn-based combat. Every journey is shaped by your choices, relationships, and the prophecy guiding your destiny. Travel across iconic territories including ThunderClan’s dense forests, RiverClan’s marshlands, ShadowClan’s dark pine swamps, and WindClan’s open moors. Climb trees, pounce through undergrowth, track scents, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the mysteries of Star Clan itself. Customize your cat with unique appearances, accessories, attack moves, and den decorations while building your reputation within the Clan. Encounter original characters alongside iconic cats from the Warrior Cats universe as you experience untold stories.

items.name: Pokémon Legends: Z-A – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Mega Dimension - Nintendo Switch 2
items.description: Lumiose City—a home for people and Pokémon alike. Thanks to an urban redevelopment plan driven by Quasartico Inc., the lush greenery of verdant parks intermingles with facilities using the latest cutting-edge technology. A lot has changed here since the days of the Pokémon X and Pokémon Y games! Choose Chikorita, Tepig, or Totodile as your first partner Pokémon, and then set off on a grand adventure! Your journey will take you to all manner of sights in the streets arrayed around Prism Tower, including shops, restaurants, and places called wild zones—where Pokémon roam free. As you catch, train, and battle Pokémon, there will be plenty of people to meet too—like AZ, the enigmatic owner of Hotel Z, and Team MZ, the crew that aims to keep Lumiose a peaceful place. And with performance upgrades for the Nintendo Switch 2 system, you’ll experience Lumiose City like never before: with enhanced resolution and frame rates! Step onto the battlefield and command your Pokémon directly—there are no turns! For the first time in the Pokémon RPG series, Trainers and their Pokémon can both move around in real-time battles, and your Pokémon will unleash their moves when you tell them to. Strategically swapping out your Pokémon and accounting for each move’s timing and area of effect will greatly help you in this style of battle. Harness the power of Mega Evolution! Unleash your Pokémon’s hidden energy to temporarily transform its appearance, enhance its capabilities, and perhaps even change its type. Use this power wisely and try to overcome your toughest challenges, like those posed by the rampaging Rogue Mega-Evolved Pokémon across Lumiose City. Investigate these dangerous incidents so you can put a stop to them—you may even encounter powerful Mega-Evolved Pokémon along the way! You’re invited to join the Z-A Royale, a competition for Pokémon Trainers to test their skills and determine who’s strongest. Each night, a battle zone for the competition will appear. Prepare yourself by spending the day catching and training Pokémon, then venture into the battle zone to take on other Trainers. Be strategic and complete bonus card challenges as you battle to speed up your climb from Rank Z to Rank A. Reach the top, and you might just have a wish granted.

items.name: Even Realities - Even G2 B Smart Glasses - Grey - Gray
items.description: Even G2 redefines the boundary between style and substance, offering the world’s most wearable display smart glasses for everday. Designed with a "minimalism" philosophy, and with titanium temples, magnesium frame, the Even G2 features a sleek, camera-free aesthetic that looks and feels like premium eyewear, making it perfect for all-day professional and social use. Behind its 2 stylish frames lies a powerful Micro-LED engine that projects an ultra-clear, private display only you can see. Whether it’s powerful Conversate, real-time Translation, proactive Even AI, glanceable Health, hands-free Navigation, intuitive Dashboard, discreet Notifications, or an integrated Teleprompt for flawless presentations, the Even G2 empowers you with essential information without ever disconnecting you from the world around you. And with the Even Hub, you unlock a whole lot of applications, built by the Even Realities community.

items.name: EA SPORTS FC 27 - Nintendo Switch 2
items.description: Welcome to The World’s Game in EA SPORTS FC™ 27.  *Certain content & features, including The Grounds mode (including Clubs) is available only on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PC and Nintendo Switch 2 versions.

items.name: Minecraft Nintendo Switch 2 - Nintendo Switch 2
items.description: Build whatever you can imagine in your own infinite world that’s unique in every playthrough. Discover biomes, resources and mobs, and craft your way through a world filled with surprises in the ultimate sandbox game. Experience unforgettable adventures as you face mysterious foes, traverse exciting landscapes, and travel to perilous dimensions. Vibrant Visuals is Minecraft’s biggest official visual enhancement – delivering a dazzling cosmetic upgrade with a new modern graphics pipeline and an array of visual improvements. Sunrises are more vivid, water reflects, forests become shaded, and more! Explore a custom Mario-themed world in the Super Mario Mash-Up Pack, with Vibrant Visuals enabled! The pack also features 15 tracks and 40 player skins inspired by the iconic Super Mario series. Have a blast with friends, whether you’re sitting on the same couch in split screen or miles apart in cross-platform play for console, mobile and PC. Connect with millions of players on community servers or subscribe to Realms Plus to play with up to 10 friends on your own private server. Get creator-made add-ons, thrilling worlds, and stylish cosmetics on Minecraft Marketplace. Subscribe to Marketplace Pass (or Realms Plus) to access 150+ worlds, skin & textures packs, and more – refreshed monthly.

items.name: Hollow Knight: Silksong - PlayStation 5
items.description: Hollow Knight: Silksong is the epic sequel to Hollow Knight, the award-winning action adventure. Journey to all-new lands, discover new powers, battle vast hordes of bugs and beasts and uncover secrets tied to your nature and your past.

items.name: Until Dawn 2 - PlayStation 5
items.description: A team of secretly sceptical ghost hunters lands a TV deal after one of their social media stunts goes viral. Their new gig takes them to an abandoned resort on a remote desert island, where a woman’s chilling story of demons and ghostly phenomena promises a killer television debut. Strange events begin to unfold, and intrigue turns to alarm as a ghostly boy and his vengeful mother drag the team into a nightmarish survival scenario where they may actually die for likes. From Firesprite, every relationship, conversation and split-second decision shapes who lives and who dies before sunrise. EVERYONE CAN LIVE. EVERYONE CAN DIE: Guide a cast of playable characters through a branching night of terror where every decision carries visible consequences. Shape relationships, trust and survival through dialogue choices and split-second reactions. Think fast and expect the unexpected as your story heads towards one of several thrilling endings. Replay to take different twists and turns and uncover completely different outcomes. MODERN SUPERNATURAL HORROR: Step into a mystery rooted in guilt, folklore and escalating dread rather than cheap jump scares. Contrast the island’s tropical beauty with the horror hidden beneath its surface. Search rich shadows for clues and study intricate settings ripe with environmental storytelling. Uncover a tragedy born of heartbreak and sorrow, and the vengeance it left behind. MEET YOUR STREAM TEAM: Meet a cast of fame seekers and social stars brought to life by a star-studded crew of performers. Watch friendships fracture as ambition, fear and blame spread through the group. Analyse minute facial expressions in conversations rendered in incredible detail on PS5. Grab a friend and share the scares by passing the controller to solve puzzles and dodge death together.

items.name: Fable - PlayStation 5
items.description: Pre-order Fable now and receive the Pre-Order Content Pack at release featuring the Chicken Suit (Cosmetic Outfit), Wild Flower Bouquet (In-Game Gift), Toy Chicken (In-Game Gift), and Scones & Jam Picnic Hamper (In-Game Gift).* Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed.

items.name: Alienware - 32" QHD 240Hz 1ms FreeSync Premium Curved Gaming Monitor with HDR (HDMI, DisplayPort) - Black
items.description: Performance meets big QHD visuals. Get drawn into your games with a large 32-inch screen featuring QHD (2560 x 1440) resolution and smooth, responsive gameplay.

items.name: Alienware - 34" UWQHD QD-OLED 280Hz .03ms FreeSync Premium Pro and G-SYNC Compatible Curved Gaming Monitor w/HDR (HDMI, DisplayPort) - Black
items.description: Dive into ultrawide immersion with the AW3426DW, featuring QD-OLED Penta Tandem technology and RGB stripe subpixels for vibrant, true-to-life colour performance.

items.name: Razer - Basilisk V4 Pro Ergonomic Gaming Mouse with 8000 Hz Polling and Chroma RGB - Wireless - Black
items.description: Where immersion meets customization, the Razer Basilisk V4 Pro pushes both further than ever. Engineered with cutting-edge technologies, this wireless ergonomic RGB gaming mouse adapts to your playstyle with unmatched precision, speed, and control. Take command with the Razer HyperScroll Tilt Wheel Gen-2, offering dual tactile modes, ultra-smooth free-spin, and Smart-Reel auto switching for seamless scrolling. Powered by the Razer™ Focus Pro 50K Optical Sensor Gen-3, enjoy pixel-perfect tracking with 50K DPI, 930 IPS, and Frame Sync for ultra-low latency performance. Play longer with up to 200 hours of battery life on Razer HyperSpeed Wireless Gen-2, delivering fast, stable connectivity with up to 8000 Hz polling in both wired and wireless modes. With 14 programmable controls—including a multi-function trigger, M1 edge button, and 3 side buttons—you have endless macros and commands at your fingertips. Immerse yourself with 7-zone Razer Chroma RGB underglow, customizable from 16.8 million colors and reactive across 300+ games. Built with Razer Optical Mouse Switches Gen-4, experience crisp, responsive clicks rated for over 100 million actuations. Seamlessly connect across your setup with 5-way multi-device support, including HyperSpeed Wireless, Bluetooth, and wired mode—switch instantly between devices with ease.

items.name: SteelSeries - QcK Cloth Gaming Mouse Pad (XXL) - Neon Sunset Edition - Neon Multicolor
items.description: The game-changing QcK line of mousepads from SteelSeries has sold over 15 million units. Our micro-woven cloth technology, high thread count, and smooth surface optimize mouse tracking accuracy. Durable and easy-to-clean, expect pixel-perfect tracking for everyday use or competitive gaming.

items.name: SteelSeries - Sensei Pro Wireless Optical Symmetrical Gaming Mouse with 8K Polling – Ultra-Wideband/RF for PC - Wireless - Black
items.description: The SteelSeries Sensei Pro gaming mouse delivers true 8K wireless over Ultra Wideband for insane performance, unlocking unparalleled speed, stability, and precision for competitive gaming. Combined with hot-swappable batteries, a precision 42K optical sensor, ultra-fast optical switches, 9K over-polling, and full or mini size options (53 grams/49 grams), the Sensei Pro gives competitive players the freedom to perform at their best without compromise.

items.name: Logitech - G502 X PLUS Wireless Gaming Mouse for Desktop with HERO 44K Sensor and 13 Controls, USB-C mouse for PC, Mac - Wireless - Dark Lilac
items.description: G502 X PLUS is the newest iteration of the world’s most popular gaming mouse, reinvented with breakthrough innovations. It features hybrid optical-mechanical LIGHTFORCE switches for incredible speed and tactical reliability, alongside the all-new, sub-micron HERO 44K sensor. Updated LIGHTSPEED wireless delivers a 68% faster response rate with an optimized battery. Complete with a reversible, removable DPI-shift button, a dual-mode hyper-fast scroll wheel, and an ultra-lightweight design, this iconic weapon ensures absolute execution. It comes fully loaded with a customizable, flowing 8-LED LIGHTSYNC RGB array and is available in premium black or white colorways.

items.name: SteelSeries - Rival Pro Wireless Optical Ergonomic Gaming Mouse with 8K Polling – Ultra-Wideband/RF for PC - Wireless - Black

items.description: Welcome to Mt. Holly, the mysterious manor of shifting rooms. In Blue Prince, you embark on a genre-defying experience, filled with a unique mix of mystery, strategy, and puzzles that weave together to create an unforgettable adventure. But will your unpredictable path lead you to the rumored Room 46? This is a full game on Switch 2 cartridge.

items.name: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival Deluxe Edition - Nintendo Switch 2
items.description: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival challenges you to intense arcade brawling in the unforgiving world of AMC’s The Walking Dead. Play as iconic survivors Rick Grimes, Daryl Dixon, and Michonne while fighting through walker-infested tunnels, devastated settlements, and hostile strongholds packed with explosive encounters. Face Alexandria’s most ruthless foes, the Saviors led by Negan, along with overwhelming waves of Walkers as you unleash crushing combos, signature weapon attacks, and devastating finishers in a relentless battle for survival.

items.name: Minecraft Dungeons II Deluxe Edition - Nintendo Switch
items.description: Brave the Unknown.Drop the pickaxe, grab a sword, and charge into a thrilling new adventure in the Minecraft Dungeons II Deluxe Edition, featuring unique cosmetics, pre-order cosmetics, and 2 DLCs!* Journey through unexplored lands in a quest to stop a new evil from causing chaos in not one, but two worlds. Clash with menacing foes in explosive encounters and fight your way through hordes of mobs that will do everything in their power to stop you from saving the day. The challenges will be tougher than ever, so face them either solo or with up to 4 players in online or couch co-op. With a crisis upon us, will you and your friends rise to meet it?

items.name: RAYMAN LEGENDS RETOLD Launch Edition - Nintendo Switch 2
items.description: Embark on a bold reimagining of the acclaimed platformer, filled with new content and narrative twists.

items.name: Diablo IV: Age of Hatred Collection [Code in Box] - Nintendo Switch 2
items.description: Diablo IV is the definitive action-RPG experience where the fate of Sanctuary hangs in the balance as Mephisto, the Prime Evil of Hatred, spreads his corruption across the world. Embark on a sweeping dark fantasy campaign where unlikely heroes arise, ancient foes stir, and no soul is safe. Battle endless evils, forge legendary builds, and fight for Sanctuary’s future across a beautifully crafted, nightmarish world. Experience the complete Diablo IV Age of Hatred story spanning multiple campaigns. This bundle instantly unlocks the Diablo IV base game, Vessel of Hatred expansion, and Lord of Hatred expansion. Play through a massive, immersive campaign and master eight distinct classes, including the all-new Paladin and Warlock. With instant access to Vessel of Hatred, take up the Spiritborn class and explore the deadly region of Nahantu, then expand your journey to the Isles of Skovos in Diablo IV: Lord of Hatred. Confront Lilith’s cultists and, as the saga continues, Mephisto’s zealots. Uncover long-buried secrets and grow stronger through robust endgame challenges with full cross-progression and cross-play.¹ You'll start your adventure with 14 Character Slots and 7 Stash Tabs. Plus, instantly unlock 3 Decor Items in World of Warcraft. [2]

items.name: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered - Deluxe Edition [Nintendo Switch 2] - Nintendo Switch 2
items.description: Return to Cyrodiil in the Definitive Fantasy RPG ExperienceRediscover one of the greatest role-playing adventures ever created with The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered for Nintendo Switch 2. Journey across the sprawling province of Cyrodiil as you confront the growing threat of the Oblivion Crisis, explore ancient ruins, join legendary guilds, and forge your own destiny in a living world filled with endless possibilities.Featuring beautifully remastered visuals, refined gameplay, and the freedom to create your own unique hero, this iconic open-world RPG invites both longtime fans and newcomers to experience an epic tale of heroism, exploration, and unforgettable adventure.The gates of Oblivion have opened… and Tamriel's fate rests in your hands!Features:Explore the vast province of Cyrodiil, filled with bustling cities, ancient dungeons, hidden treasures, and unforgettable quests.Create and customize your hero while mastering powerful magic, stealth, melee combat, and a wide variety of skills.Join iconic factions, shape the world through meaningful choices, and uncover hundreds of hours of exploration and adventure.Experience enhanced visuals, refined gameplay, and modern improvements in the definitive remastered edition of the acclaimed fantasy RPG.

items.name: HyperX - Cloud Alpha Air Wired Open-Back Gaming Headset for PC, PS5, PS4, Xbox X|S, Nintendo Switch, Mac, and Mobile - Black
items.description: When it's time to play or create, don't settle for a headset that cuts corners. The HyperX Cloud Alpha Air is the open-back headset that keeps the bass, something traditional open-backs simply can't do. The HyperX Bass Tube maintains the low end while still delivering the life-like audio experience of an open-back headset, so you get the best of both worlds. Hear yourself naturally, catch every footstep with pinpoint accuracy on a massive soundstage, and say goodbye to ear pressure buildup, all thanks to the open earcup design. And with luxurious Ultrasuede materials and plush padding, you can play, stream, and chat comfortably through even the longest sessions. HyperX-tuned audio gives you a competitive edge without sacrificing the immersive detail and impact of video game sound design. The metal-reinforced headband and sliders are built to survive knocks, drops, and everyday wear,1 and USB-C, USB-A, 3.5mm, and a USB dongle keep you connected across PC, console, and more. Most open-back headsets stop there — but with HyperX NGENUITY, you can tune Cloud Alpha Air exactly to your preference.

items.name: Terranigma - Nintendo Switch 2
items.description: Thematic boldness. Stunning character design. Excellent music. Smooth gameplay. Terranigma had it all... except a modern re-release. Now, the beloved action JRPG classic is back for the first time since 1995! The Earth is a hollow sphere with two sides: an external Lightside and an internal Darkside. In the Darkside village of Crysta, the mischievous Ark lives unaware of the world beyond. But one day, he opens a forbidden door and sets in motion events that will change the world. For decades, Terranigma has captivated players with its emotional story and transformative journey. Now you can (re)experience its magic yourself! In 1995, the two-dimensional Japanese role-playing genre was at its absolute peak, but even among the beloved giants of the 16-bit era, Terranigma stands out with its unique world-building, snappy combat, enchanting soundtrack, and stunning graphics. It is truly a masterpiece, yet despite this, the game has never been re-released. Until now.

items.name: The Witch's Bakery - Nintendo Switch 2
items.description: The Witch's Bakery is a cozy Adventure RPG about a joyful witch who opens her bakery in modern Paris. She has one special power: she can see into people's heart and heal emotions through magic!

items.name: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ - Nintendo Switch 2
items.description: Experience The Binding of Isaac’s devious blend of dungeon crawling, twin-stick shooter action and endlessly randomized replayability like never before: with friends online! Repentance+ includes the entire game—with all DLCs and hundreds of additions and improvements from updates—plus full-featured online co-op for up to four players. Play online with friends, start or join a match with strangers... and take on Mom and the twisting labyrinths of the Basement, together at last. You don’t have to go it alone.

items.name: Eternal Anima Limited Edition - Nintendo Switch 2
items.description: In a world without land, consumed by an endless sea, the floating kingdom of Urvis Ael stands as the last bastion of civilization. Its people enjoy peaceful lives under the rule of their omnipotent leader, the Almighty, bound by one unbreakable law: no progress whatsoever. After challenging this ideal, Wade is pursued as a heretic, escapes to the Forbidden Seas, and searches for a new world. As he journeys through the past and present of four lost continents, he and his companions discover what it means to inherit wisdom passed down through the ages. With Wade's powers of Psychometry, he can decipher past memories that dwell within objects, allowing him to inherit Abilities and Classes in combat. Wade also uses Future Sight in battle to predict when enemies will act and what the outcome will be each turn. Choose your commands strategically, and you can alter Wade’s predictions — Prepare for incoming attacks or act first to prevent enemy actions entirely. Crafted by a team of acclaimed RPG veterans, featuring gorgeous visuals inspired by the golden age of RPGs, and designed with modern sensibilities, Eternal Anima is an epic where you must save the past to free the present.

items.name: Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea - Nintendo Switch

Bose Immersive Audio spatializes conventional stereo content to create a broader presentation that feels less confined to the physical position of the earbuds. Each earbud incorporates four microphones, creating an eight-microphone system across the pair. The microphone array and noise-rejecting processing help isolate the user’s voice from surrounding sound and wind during calls. Either earbud can also be used independently for compatible calls and audio playback. Wireless connectivity uses Bluetooth 5.3 with a range of up to approximately 30 feet under suitable conditions. Bluetooth multipoint allows simultaneous connections with multiple compatible devices, while aptX Adaptive, Snapdragon Sound, SBC, and AAC provide a range of wireless audio options depending on the connected source. Battery life reaches up to approximately 6 hours with Immersive Audio turned off and up to approximately 4 hours with Immersive Audio enabled. The charging case provides approximately 18 additional hours of listening time, while a 20-minute quick charge can provide up to approximately two hours of playback. The charging case supports both USB-C and wireless charging, providing flexible options for recharging at home, at work, or while traveling. Three sizes of eartips and three stability-band sizes provide up to nine fit combinations, allowing the acoustic seal and physical stability to be adjusted independently. An IPX4 water-resistance rating helps protect the earbuds against sweat, splashes, and light rain during workouts and everyday activity.

items.name: My Play Watch - emoji All-Ages Gaming Smartwatch, Selective Tech, Fitness Tracker - Yellow
items.description: The emoji All-Ages Gaming Smartwatch from My Play Watch combines playful games, customizable style, and basic fitness tracking into one screen-based device designed for all ages, and it does so without connecting to the internet or social media. Built-in entertainment comes from two dedicated emoji games, emoji MERGE, a physics-based match-and-merge arcade challenge, and ASK emoji, a game built for quick, playful fun, giving wearers a couple of different ways to pass the time directly on the watch. Personal style is a major part of the design, with more than 100 watch face combinations available by mixing and matching emoji expressions, background colors, and styles, so each wearer can create a look that feels distinctly their own. All of this displays on a 1.91-inch full-color touchscreen, which shows smooth, colorful emoji graphics across both the games and the customizable watch faces. Beyond entertainment, the watch also includes fitness tracking that monitors steps, heart rate, and active calories, all presented through emoji-themed visuals that keep the health data feeling fun and approachable rather than clinical. Importantly, the watch has a non-connected design, meaning there is no Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, texting, or notification functionality, which keeps the experience focused on games, customization, and basic fitness tracking rather than messaging or social media access. Each unit also includes one Mystery Band, chosen from four possible designs, adding an element of surprise to the physical band that comes with the watch. With its two built-in emoji games, extensive watch face customization, vibrant full-color touchscreen, simple fitness tracking, and screen-focused non-connected design rounded out by a surprise Mystery Band, this smartwatch offers an engaging, self-contained device for wearers of all ages who want fun and activity tracking without internet connectivity.

Sized for smaller wrists, it features a bright 1.3" AMOLED display and the first-ever titanium fēnix watch case for lightweight comfort and lasting durability. Other highlights include a scratch-resistant sapphire lens and powerful LED flashlight with white, red or green light settings. The watch’s built-in inReach connectivity lets you leave your phone behind and still call, text or share your LiveTrack™ location from your wrist with an LTE connection — or use a satellite link for off-grid messaging (active plan required; satellite connection, SOS functionality and coverage limitations apply, making them unavailable in certain situations; some jurisdictions regulate or prohibit the use of satellite communication devices). You also get free emergency SOS messaging for up to 12 months after the free trial period. The latest Garmin stamina and endurance tracking features, including stamina curve and stamina zones, help you visualize how far, how fast and how long you can go based on your fitness gains and training history. And with 100+ activity profiles — including enhancements to rowing and rucking — you’ll discover new ways to push your limits. There’s also a Garmin Epic feature that lets you record and share multiple days of activities, along with health and performance stats, as a cohesive storyline. Explore with preloaded multicontinent TopoActive maps that are routable, smoother and more intuitive than ever — adding confidence to your navigation, even if you change course along the way.
